in_sanskrit.name: शर्वण्क
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्वण् (sharvaṇ) means abundance and क (k) is a suffix that denotes the possessor. So Sharvank means God of abundance.

in_hindi.name: शर्वंक
in_hindi.long_meaning: अभि (abhi) means towards and लाष (lāṣ) means desire. So Sharvank means one who desires towards something.

in_tamil.name: ஶர்வங்க
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஶர்வ (śarv) means God and ங்க (ṅg) is a suffix that denotes the possessor. So Sharvank means God's possession.

in_telugu.name: శర్వంగ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్వ (śarv) means God and ఙ్గ (ṅg) is a suffix that denotes the possessor. So Sharvank means God's possession.

in_marathi.name: Sharvank
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Sharva is a form of Lord Shiva, who is considered the God of Knowledge and the God of Six Directions. He is also known as Kshetrapala, the guardian of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Sharvank
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharvank একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Lord Sharva is a form of Lord Shiva, who is considered the God of Knowledge and the God of Six Directions. He is also known as Kshetrapala, the guardian of the universe.
